source: Approved by Thomas on 2026-11-14: 6 A transfers via replaces (including 3 neighbouring Grade 6 items taught in current Grade 5), 0 B, all 10 C rows kept active without retirement.

rows.reason: Same single retrieval: the equator is the 0-degree latitude circle separating the hemispheres. The old answer adds circumference, but the prompt does not ask for it.
The old combined prompt asks for the complete graticule, limits, meridian properties and coordinate example. New items retrieve narrower parts; no single unchanged successor.
Same single retrieval: 1 cm at 1:50 000 corresponds to 500 m.
The old four-part map-language prompt and distance calculation are distributed across several lessons. A history cannot be split across those successors.
Same single retrieval: approximately 23.5 degrees relative to the perpendicular to the orbital plane.

The compound answer joins rotation, orbit, seasons and fixed calendar dates. New lessons separate mechanisms and avoid treating solstice and equinox dates as invariant; no unchanged whole-answer successor.
The agricultural regional superlative is not a recall objective of the new package. The current Grade 6 curriculum teaches agriculture; keep active pending a separate scope decision.
The old agricultural land-use and structural-change bundle exceeds the Grade 5 introductory land-use comparison. Keep active for the later agriculture package.
Same single retrieval: name of the northern German lowland. Current official curriculum assigns German physical structures to Grade 5; including this neighbouring-grade history is only a proposal.
The old multi-part answer includes detailed elevations and geomorphology, and conflates parts of the step-land with Alpine foreland. The new broad-landscape lesson corrects and narrows this scope.
Same single retrieval: Bavaria has seven administrative districts. Grade 5 now teaches this administration; neighbouring-grade inclusion requires Thomas to approve the proposal.
All seven seats and a detailed tributary network form one old retrieval. New lesson tasks cover a smaller selection, so no mastery transfer is inferred.
The mechanism of tides is not retrieved by a new item. A protected coastal landscape example does not establish an equivalent tide-mechanism retrieval.
The detailed paired coastal morphology answer has no unchanged successor. The protected-area comparison is narrower.
Same single retrieval: regular work travel without permanent relocation is commuting. Current Grade 5 explicitly includes city-hinterland relationships; scope remains a proposal.
The metropolitan/rural comparison, demographic generalisations and constitutional framework are not the same retrieval as the Grade 5 city-functions tasks.
